body:
# Wide Vanilla is just another Vanilla+ Modpack to have fun with :)

## What is this Modpack about?

This Modpack is more on the lightwheighted side and primarily focusses on making the minecraft experience more enjoyable and relaxing while keeping the typical Mincraft feel. In Fact, you probably won't even notice that it's modified at all! (Atleast for a minute or so...) Additionally it's optimized to the very brim, so that even your on Hopes-and-Dreams-running Computing Machine can show you an enhanced version of this Game + some nice Multiplayer support


![Stunning image of a wide beach lagune framed by a wet forest and a small monument in the middle of the sea](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0c245a6d5b506838233fc18257ec5ed45c0fdf9.png)

### Performant
To ensure a smooth experience this pack contains various performance mods such as Sodium, Ferrite Core, Entity Culling and more. Adittionally everything is set up on Fabric, which is fast and lightweight. _If you want to further increase performance you might wanna disable Distant Horizons and/or JJThunder_

### Shader Compatibility
This pack features build in shader combatibility through [Iris](https://www.irisshaders.dev/) and comes with three shaders installed so anyone can choose what fits their Pc and their eyes  best. Included are:
- [Bliss Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/bliss-shader) (not supported by Distant Horizon)
- [Photon Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/photon-shader)
- [MakeUp - Ultra Fast](https://modrinth.com/shader/makeup-ultra-fast-shaders)

### Relaxing and Accessible
This Modpack offers gamplay that doesn't vary much from Vanilla so it's perfect if you're unexperienced with modded Mc or if you just don't want to worry about tech or magic mods you would need to get into first. There is even Controller-support if you're coming from Console or if you want to game from your couch. 

### Enhanced Visuals
Thanks to [WWOO](https://modrinth.com/mod/wwoo) and [JJ Thunder](https://modrinth.com/datapack/jjthunder-to-the-max) you will see incredible terrain wherever you look while using [DH](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) and if you turn it off, your world will just look like Vanilla although quiet a bit more detailed.
The End and the Nether both also got an overhaul which makes travelling in those dimensions far more intresting.
Adittionally there are a number fo mods that will make the Hud, the UI and some parts of the gameplay a little bit more satisfying.

### Additions
The bigger not-so-Vanilla Content additions of the pack consist of [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated/versions) and [The Aether](https://modrinth.com/mod/aether/versions). The Aether is a whole new dimension, the pardon to the Nether, in which you can live, explore an fight Bosses. Farmer's Deleight on the other hand allows you to enhance your cooking skills. Cut Veggies, make Salad and grill Burgers.

### Multiplayer Fun
And you can do all of this toghether with your Buddies!
Thanks to [e4mc](https://modrinth.com/mod/e4mc) one of you can easily host his own server (cost free) for all to connect to. This Modpack even holds some more fun interactions for you and your friends, but I'll let you find out yourself ;)





**Currently there is exessive testing and experiencing required, therefore the Alpha release. But Fear Not! This will be handeled in no time and soon a perfected version can be released.**

_If you encounter Errors, Problems or have any Suggestions, you may join my [Discord](https://discord.gg/GQaRy92xFb) for now since I dont have an Github or similar._
